# stopwords-iso (vendored)

English and French stopword lists from
[stopwords-iso](https://github.com/stopwords-iso), MIT licence (see
`LICENSE`, identical for both repositories).

- `en.json`: stopwords-iso/stopwords-en at
  `ccc8898188850d8fb019d5f69c14a6635c3bd115`
- `fr.json`: stopwords-iso/stopwords-fr at
  `069f556be89f2f08de2f1b8313084bb4610f30b4`

Copied unmodified. `src/stopwords.ts` adds Skydex's own words and
removes the few that name topics.
